diffSummary: Implemented transactional closing and ledger APIs, optimistic revisions, append-only audit and latest-event undo, idempotency keys, server-side business dates and cleanup, AES-GCM contact encryption, explicit local-v5 import planning, and private R2 presigned upload/download/delete flows.
rationale: Move all authoritative writes, audit identity, business validation, concurrency, and media access behind the authenticated API.
